basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old audio-visual tech enthusiast based in Austin, Texas. Recently got into gaming and sound systems, trying to set up my ultimate entertainment space at home. I work as a stagehand for local concerts and theater productions, which keeps me busy during weekends and evenings. I’m single, enjoy indie music festivals, and love experimenting with new tech gadgets. My online presence is mostly in the evenings and late nights after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge mainly comes from hands-on experience in the entertainment tech industry and a lot of self-teaching through online resources and community forums. I have some formal education in audio engineering, but most of my skills are practical from working in live events.
